title: pyslicer YAML config
description: Print settings for pyslicer --config YAML files. All properties are optional. Unknown properties are rejected at load time. Prefer CLI-style aliases (layer_height, outer_speed, …) when both an alias and a Model attribute name exist.

layer_height.description: Slicing layer height in mm (alias for layerHeight).

num_perimeters.description: Minimum number of perimeters (alias for number_perimeters).

perimeter_overlap_percent.description: Percent overlap between perimeters. Smaller values mean more overlap.

append_perimeters.description: Also include original STL perimeters with no offsetting.

outer_speed.description: Outer perimeter print speed in mm/s (converted to Model outer_perimeter_speed mm/min).

inner_speed.description: Inner perimeter print speed in mm/s (converted to Model inner_perimeter_speed mm/min).

infill_speed.description: Infill print speed in mm/s (converted to Model mm/min).

max_corner_speed.description: Max speed at a sharp corner in mm/s (converted to Model mm/min).

outer_perimeter_speed.description: Outer perimeter print speed in mm/min (Model-native units).

inner_perimeter_speed.description: Inner perimeter print speed in mm/min (Model-native units).

default_print_speed.description: Default print speed in mm/min (G-code F).

max_accel.description: Max print acceleration for feed planning in mm/s².

max_jerk.description: Max corner speed change Δv for feed planning in mm/s.

min_corner_angle.description: Min turn angle in degrees before accel/jerk caps apply.

minimum_retract_travel.description: Minimum travel distance in mm before retracting.

width_over_height.description: Extrusion width relative to layer height.

min_extrude.description: Minimum extrusion length threshold in mm.
